label: Microsoft Teams
terms_note: Automation allowed via a registered bot: proactive messages require the app to be INSTALLED for the user (personal scope) or in the team / group chat — otherwise 403 ForbiddenOperationException; a bot cannot create a new group chat or a new channel; blocked / uninstalled → 403 subCode MessageWritesBlocked; proactive by email / UPN not supported (use aadObjectId, personal scope only). Apps can be installed for users via Graph (userTeamwork installedApps) from the org catalog or the Teams Store. Rate limits: HTTP 429 (retry 412 / 502 / 504 too); per bot per thread: send 7 ops/s, 8/2 s, 60/30 s, 1,800/h; create conversation same; get members 14/s … 3,600/h; all bots per thread 14 sends/s; global 50 RPS per app per tenant. Graph chatMessage POST: delegated ChannelMessage.Send / ChatMessage.Send (not for personal Microsoft accounts); application permission only Teamwork.Migrate.All (migration, fees may apply).

sdks: Teams SDK / Teams AI Library (C#, TypeScript, Python), Bot Framework SDK, Microsoft Graph SDKs (learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform)

auth: 1. Azure Bot registration (app id + secret / certificate) → Teams app manifest (bot scopes personal / team / groupChat).
2. Bot gets a Bot Framework bearer token (client credentials against `login.microsoftonline.com/botframework.com`).
3. App must be INSTALLED where it messages: personal scope for 1:1, in the team / group chat otherwise; install via Graph
4. Graph delegated: `ChatMessage.Send`, `ChannelMessage.Send` (not personal Microsoft accounts); application permission

endpoints.call: Bot messaging endpoint (our HTTPS URL) receives activities `message`, `conversationUpdate` (membersAdded), `installationUpdate
endpoints.purpose: inbound / read inbox (messages to the bot)
create 1:1 conversation for proactive messages (personal scope only; 403 ForbiddenOperationException if not installed)

endpoints.call: POST …/conversations/{channelId}/activities` (with `channelData.channel.id`) · reply with root message id
endpoints.purpose: new channel thread / proactive in channel
delegated send when the tenant user signs in

reference.limits: - Per bot per thread: send 7 / s, 8 / 2 s, 60 / 30 s, 1,800 / h; create conversation same; get members / conversations 14 / s, 16 / 2 s, 120 / 30 s, 3,600 / h. All bots per thread: 14 sends / s, 16 / 2 s. Global 50 RPS per app per tenant. 429 (also retry 412 / 502 / 504) with exponential back-off + jitter. - Cannot create a group chat or a channel; cannot address by email / UPN; blocked / uninstalled → 403 `MessageWritesBlocked`. - Proactive messages must state why the user receives them and offer opt-out (Microsoft guidance).

adapter.rate_note: Teams service limits apply per app per tenant; sending messages is limited to a few per second per chat or channel; HTTP 429 + Retry-After (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/throttling-limits).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Application (client) ID of the Microsoft Entra app registration.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client secret of the app registration ('Only required for web apps'); leave empty for a public client. Sent in the form body of POST https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent including offline_access and the delegated scopes User.Read Chat.ReadWrite ChatMessage.Send ChannelMessage.Send ChannelMessage.Read.All (work or school accounts only; personal accounts are 'Not supported'). Microsoft may return a new refresh token on every refresh; the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/<platform>.json (mode 0600).

config_fields.name: team_id
config_fields.help: Team id whose channel threads get_thread and reply use (GET /me/joinedTeams).

config_fields.name: user_id
config_fields.help: Entra object id of the signed-in user (GET /me → id); required by mark_read.

config_fields.name: tenant_id
config_fields.help: Tenant id of the signed-in user; required by mark_read.

send.note: `to` is a chat id (19:…@thread.v2 or 19:…@unq.gbl.spaces; GET /me/chats). Delegated ChatMessage.Send; 'Application' permission is migration-only.

list_inbound.note: Messages of ONE chat (`channel` = chat id, required), newest first; 'Maximum allowed $top value is 50'. `page` is ignored (nextLink paging); `since` is not sent. text is body.content (HTML for most messages).

get_thread.note: Replies to a channel message: `channel` is the channel id, `thread_id` the root message id, and the team comes from config team_id.

reply.note: Reply in a channel thread (`channel` = channel id, `thread_id` = root message id, team from config team_id). 'Only the body property is mandatory'.

mark_read.note: Marks the chat `channel` read for the signed-in user (config user_id and tenant_id); 204.

evidence: host graph.microsoft.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
